description: This file defines a 'Loader' UI component using Lightning.js framework. It creates an animated loading indicator composed of three circles that fade in and out in sequence.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A UI component for displaying a loading animation consisting of three animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates a recurring interval that toggles the alpha property of the component to create a fade-in and fade-out animation.
